title: Advance Wars: Days of Ruin
subtitle: Strategy after the catastrophe
summary: Advance Wars: Days of Ruin is Intelligent Systems' Nintendo DS strategy game set after a meteor disaster has devastated civilisation. Known as Dark Conflict in Europe, it follows survivors trying to organise protection and rebuild amid competing military forces. The familiar turn-based contest of infantry, vehicles, aircraft and ships remains, but the new cast and damaged world change its tone. A position on the map is now presented as a resource for people struggling to survive, giving the series' territorial decisions a more severe narrative setting.
body: Advance Wars: Days of Ruin is Intelligent Systems' Nintendo DS strategy game set after a meteor disaster has devastated civilisation. Known as Dark Conflict in Europe, it follows survivors trying to organise protection and rebuild amid competing military forces. The familiar turn-based contest of infantry, vehicles, aircraft and ships remains, but the new cast and damaged world change its tone. A position on the map is now presented as a resource for people struggling to survive, giving the series' territorial decisions a more severe narrative setting.

Commanding officers can join a chosen unit, creating an area around it in which nearby forces receive benefits. Their influence is therefore tied to a visible position on the battlefield. Moving that unit forward can support an attack while also exposing an important part of the army. Unit experience adds another reason to preserve a successful force. These changes bring strategic advantages down onto the map, where the player can see which units are protected, which are isolated and what a retreat would give up.

Factories and captured properties sustain the familiar cycle of income, production and advance. Terrain and unit matchups determine where that investment can be used safely, while new units and changed rules require fresh judgement from returning players. Multiplayer and custom maps extend the system beyond the campaign's ruined world. Days of Ruin shows how recognisable pieces can support a different atmosphere: the clear grid still makes a complicated battle readable, but the story surrounding each contested settlement gives its capture another kind of weight.

Build a way out of the ruins
